expect_red: [real] a nav mark under the pointer offers the card and nothing else: no native tooltip on it or on any ancestor up to its row

mutations.contract: VA.alertBadge writes a native `title` only on the arm with NO card handler. A badge that opens a card and carries a tooltip is the same words in two formats, and the browser drops its plain box over the formatted one.
mutations.note: The mutation is the pre-2026-09-30 shape: the title set unconditionally, before the `onCardShow` branch. It is in views/dom.js rather than views/nav.js on purpose -- the badge is shared with both of views/stack.js's tables, and this is the one line that decides it for all three.
